title: Salutations to the Goddess
translation: Salutations to the Goddess, the Great Goddess, to the auspicious one, always. Salutations to Prakṛti, to the gracious one. With minds controlled, we bow to her.
translation_hi: देवी को, महादेवी को, कल्याणमयी शिवा को सदा नमस्कार है। प्रकृति को, भद्रा को नमस्कार है। हम संयमित होकर उन्हें प्रणाम करते हैं।

words.note: With the dative: नमः X-ai = 'salutation to X'.
Dative of devī. Feminine -ī nouns take -यै.
sma makes the present past or emphatic.

grammar: Namaḥ + dative: salutation always takes the dative ('to'): देव्यै, शिवायै, प्रकृत्यै. Compare शिवाय नमः.
Feminine dative -ai: devī → देव्यै, śivā → शिवायै, prakṛti → प्रकृत्यै.
Setting: in chapter 5 of the Durgā Saptaśatī, the gods, defeated by the demons Śumbha and Niśumbha, go to the Himalaya and praise the Goddess with this hymn.
